title: FOL-Proof: Verifying LLM Text-to-Logic Translations via Deterministic Semantics
abstract: arXiv:2611.33078v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used to translate natural-language statements into first-order logic (FOL) to improve reasoning. However, LLMs are prone to errors, and so a semantically unfaithful FOL formula could corrupt downstream reasoning. We present FOL-Proof, a semantic firewall pipeline that validates LLM-generated FOL translations against independently derived linguistic interpretations. FOL-Proof operates by deterministically obtaining a pool of candidate translations via semantic analysis tools, such as the English Resource Grammar and Minimal Recursion Semantics; then applying an SMT solver to check each derived reading for logical equivalence to the LLM-generated formula. If the translation is faithful it is accepted; otherwise, it is rejected, or optionally repaired via repeated invocations to the LLM. translated_title: FOL-Proof：基于确定性语义验证大语言模型文本到逻辑的翻译
translated_abstract: 大语言模型越来越多地被用于将自然语言语句转换为一阶逻辑（FOL）以增强推理能力。然而，大语言模型容易出错，语义上不忠实的一阶逻辑公式可能会破坏下游推理。我们提出了FOL-Proof，一个语义防火墙流水线，它通过独立推导的语言学解释来验证大语言模型生成的一阶逻辑翻译。FOL-Proof的工作方式是：首先通过语义分析工具（如英语资源语法ERG和最小递归语义MRS）确定性地获得候选翻译池；然后应用SMT求解器检查每个推导出的语义读法与大语言模型生成的公式是否逻辑等价。如果翻译是忠实的，则接受；否则拒绝，或可选地通过反复调用大语言模型进行修复。该流程采取保守策略：当搜索不完整、遇到不支持的语法结构或检查结果不确定时，会做出绝对的……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了FOL-Proof语义防火墙流水线，通过英语资源语法等语义分析工具确定性地生成候选翻译，并利用SMT求解器进行逻辑等价性检查，从而独立验证大语言模型生成的一阶逻辑翻译的语义忠实性。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces FOL-Proof, a semantic firewall pipeline that validates LLM-generated FOL translations by deterministically deriving candidate interpretations via semantic analysis tools (ERG and MRS) and checking logical equivalence with an SMT solver.
